requirements.statement: LedgerEvent v2 must be a deterministic audit projection of one valid ReportingEntry and must carry both the exact ReportingEntry digest and previous ReportingEntry digest; independent consumers must reconstruct the ReportingEntry body, validate FlowType and exact debit-credit balance, and reject digest mismatch.

AccountingClose v2 must seal a strict genesis-based LedgerEvent v2 prefix with sequence exactly 1..N, continuous ReportingEntry digests, event_count equal to FinancialSnapshot sequence, and final ReportingEntry digest equal to FinancialSnapshot ledger_last_entry_digest.

LedgerInclusionProof v2 must bind both the exact LedgerEvent v2 digest and its underlying ReportingEntry digest to one AccountingClose v2 Merkle root and must not grant posting, recognition or execution authority.

EconomicCycleTrace v6 must require LedgerEvent v2, FinancialSnapshot v2, AccountingClose v2 and LedgerInclusionProof v2 as explicit final accounting phases while keeping external trust finalization non-circular and separate.

A fully re-hashed downstream accounting bundle must still be rejected when its LedgerEvent economics differ from the independent RevenueRecognition v2 amounts; gross debit and recognized-revenue, tax and refund-reserve credit components must remain exactly bound.

CommitmentEnvelope v5 must use an immutable v5 schema-policy profile, require latest AccountingClose/Proof/Trace generations by default, and finalize only a complete externally-finalizable Trace v6 containing AccountingClose and LedgerInclusionProof phases.

The SINERGYCHAIN control plane must independently verify LedgerEvent v2, FinancialSnapshot v2, AccountingClose v2, LedgerInclusionProof v2, Trace v6 and Commitment v5 relationships while exposing READ_ONLY_VERIFIED/READ_ONLY_BLOCKED only and never acquiring accounting, posting, signing or execution authority.
